topic: 最长前缀匹配原生配置
title: 配置并查询最长前缀匹配，区分前缀长度与路由偏好
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。
body:
## 环境与初始材料
非root Linux、BIRD 2；routes.conf含broad与narrow两个静态协议，narrow误写为10.20.0.0/16。平台启动无网络监听的BIRD实例，只有工作区控制socket；无Kernel/Direct/OSPF，系统路由不变。

## 操作任务
修正routes.conf内narrow的网段，使10.2.0.0/16中的任意地址命中narrow，其他10.0.0.0/8地址仍命中broad。保留broad的preference 200/blackhole和narrow的preference 50/unreachable，不通过改变偏好或删除广域路由回避最长前缀匹配。两个静态协议只进入BIRD内部表，不向系统安装路由。

## 提交产物
routes.conf，保留题给结构，仅修正目标网段。执行后生成lookup-observations.json。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py让真实BIRD解析配置并执行birdc show route for：验证10.2网段首尾及随机地址命中/16，即使它的协议偏好较低；其他10网段命中/8；无匹配地址显示Network not found。记录原生查询输出并确认内核路由未改变。 所有断言通过退出0。本题验证内部路由查询，不做真实网络连通性测试；blackhole/unreachable仅用于区分结果。

失败示例：把10.2.0.0写成/24只覆盖其中一个小网段，首个地址可能通过但尾部和随机地址会失败；将10.20误认为10.2会命中错误范围。
rubric: 验证恢复结果与回退条件

test_files.checks/check.py:
import pathlib,re,subprocess,time,os,json,secrets
assert os.getuid()!=0
fragment=pathlib.Path('routes.conf').read_text()
pattern=r'\s*protocol static broad\s*\{\s*ipv4\s*\{\s*preference 200;\s*\};\s*route ([0-9./]+) blackhole;\s*\}\s*protocol static narrow\s*\{\s*ipv4\s*\{\s*preference 50;\s*\};\s*route ([0-9./]+) unreachable;\s*\}\s*'
assert re.fullmatch(pattern,fragment),'keep the two private static protocols and their stated preferences/actions'
before=subprocess.check_output(['ip','-j','route','show','table','all'])
pathlib.Path('runtime.conf').write_text('log stderr all;\nrouter id 192.0.2.1;\n'+fragment)
checked=subprocess.run(['bird','-p','-c','runtime.conf'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=2)
assert checked.returncode==0,checked.stderr
log=open('bird.log','w');process=subprocess.Popen(['bird','-f','-c','runtime.conf','-s','bird.ctl','-P','bird.pid'],stdout=log,stderr=log)
observations=[]
try:
    for _ in range(100):
        assert process.poll() is None
        if pathlib.Path('bird.ctl').exists():break
        time.sleep(.01)
    samples=['10.2.0.1','10.2.255.254','10.2.'+str(secrets.randbelow(254)+1)+'.'+str(secrets.randbelow(254)+1)]
    samples+=['10.1.0.1','10.3.0.1','10.255.255.254','192.0.2.9']
    for address in samples:
        result=subprocess.run(['birdc','-s','bird.ctl','show','route','for',address,'all'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=2)
        observations.append({'address':address,'stdout':result.stdout,'exit':result.returncode})
        if address.startswith('10.2.'):
            assert result.returncode==0 and '10.2.0.0/16' in result.stdout and '[narrow ' in result.stdout and 'unreachable' in result.stdout,result.stdout
        elif address.startswith('10.'):
            assert result.returncode==0 and '10.0.0.0/8' in result.stdout and '[broad ' in result.stdout and 'blackhole' in result.stdout,result.stdout
        else:assert 'Network not found' in result.stdout,result.stdout
    pathlib.Path('lookup-observations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'lookups':observations,'kernel_forwarding_verified':False},indent=2))
finally:
    if process.poll() is None:process.terminate()
    try:process.wait(timeout=2)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=2)
    log.close()
    assert before==subprocess.check_output(['ip','-j','route','show','table','all'])
